note: v3: the seed breathes - the five voices drift up to half a beat and back, re-locking by 3:19
v6: first light - the seed's opening statement echoes out (ping-pong) and a low cello D swells under the intro
v7: the seed is recognised - the kalimba states E1 plainly on the crest as the five voices lock
v8: the shadow catches up - the cello cantus doubles its pace (E1 at half speed) into the fall
v16: the whistle tries the hook where the scattered cycles fall in phase (152 D A, 168 D A C, 176 D A C G), never the last E
v20: the hook first - the whistle's E1 alone over scatter and pedal at A, the band (bass, shekere, warm fifth) drops in two bars later
v21: the whistle states E1 once more as the lock exhales (300), then at half speed into the fall (320), handing the hook into the overlap
v22: the album breathes first - a soft airy 'haa' on D from the far choir before the whistle's first E1
v27: the seed alone - the five voices step out for the lock's 2nd phrase and the whistle plays E1 twice over the cell, cello and organ
v28: the voices fall together - each scattered voice bounces faster and faster into its place in E1 at the crest
v29: the floor walks the seed - the triangle bass leaves its D-A drone and walks E1 (D A C G E) at a quarter speed under the cello
v31: the voices let go - the mirror of the crest's bounce: each voice slows its repeats at its own rate as the lock ends
v32: the seed is answered - the ks-harp answers the whistle's two E1s at A with E1's inversion (D G E A C)
v35: the choir hums the seed - E1 x4 hummed with closed lips from 0:18, opening into 'ah' on the last note
v38: the floor drops for the breath - shaker, bass and seeds out for the two bars before the build; the choir's mm-haa over pad and cello
v39: the mirror takes turns - glock E1 and harp inversion alternate statements in the lock's last eight bars
v42: the hum holds - hum_even 0.5 on the opening hum, an even line instead of one sinking on its high notes
v48: the crystal answers itself - every other E1 cycle an octave lower in beats 256-288
v51: the cello rises to the seed - its slow E1 an octave up for beats 120-144, the seed's own height
v53: the last hum stands back - five singers with their own vibrato, vowels and depth, in the hall
v55: the held breath before the meeting - everything that moves stops for the two beats before the crest
v56: the seed's rhythm before its tune - the clave taps E1's five onsets from beat 164 to the drop
v57: the drum falls into the seed's time - from the exhale the bodhran beats on each E1 cycle's first note (every 5 beats)
v60: the mirror rises - the harp's second inverted E1 an octave up
v63: the choir exhales - two mm-haa sighs after the crest (267.5, 283.5)
v66: the hook accretes 1-2-3-4-5 - a one-note tease (D, on the D voice at 143) before D A, D A C, D A C G
v67: the end becomes the beginning - the shakuhachi's last backwards D held until the whistle's hook takes it at 143
v68: the crest blooms - one soft tam-tam stroke on the crest's downbeat
v70: the hand on the drum - a soft bodhran triplet roll (six rising taps) calls the seeds back at 288
v74: the ground begins to move - the shekere's 5-beat groove breathes in under the clave from 57 (0:44), swelling into A's groove at 72
